description: Household electricity and gas tariffs in these markets: Belgium, Netherlands, United Kingdom, Spain, United States, France, Italy, Austria, Ireland. Returns the tariffs that fit the stated fuel, region, meter, contract and green needs, ranked by cost over the horizon (unit rates x yearly consumption, standing charges, supplier charges on the price card, welcome credits), each part shown, with the period the prices apply to, source link and check date. Prices are compared on one stated basis per market; parts that are the same for every supplier at an address (e.g. network charges, taxes) are named, not computed. Dynamic hourly tariffs are listed, not costed. Per market: Belgium: supplier energy cost and fixed fee incl. VAT; region Flanders, Wallonia or Brussels; gas in kWh. Netherlands: supplier delivery prices incl. energy tax and VAT; national prices (no region); gas in m³ (gas_m3), as Dutch suppliers price it. United Kingdom: all-in unit rates and standing charges incl. VAT, as on the Tariff Information Label; one of 14 regions; unit rates per kWh and standing charges per day, in GBP; Ofgem's price-cap level for the region is returned as a reference line, not an offer. Spain: energy and power terms incl. peajes y cargos, before taxes; zone (peninsula, Baleares, Canarias, Ceuta, Melilla); contracted power in kW (contracted_kw) for the power term; period_shares for three-period (P1/P2/P3) tariffs. United States: electricity supply (generation) price per kWh as the state regulator's shopping site lists it, in USD; electricity only, Pennsylvania, New York, Massachusetts, Washington DC and Rhode Island (supplier offers) plus default-service prices in PA, IL, MA, MD and RI; region = the utility area (e.g. PECO, PPL, Con Edison, National Grid, Eversource, ComEd, BGE) or a city it serves; prices per kWh in USD. France: all-in regulated price incl. network costs, taxes and VAT (TTC), as CRE publishes it; electricity only: the regulated Tarif Bleu (TRVE) as CRE publishes it, Base and peak/off-peak (HP/HC) per subscribed power; give the subscribed power in kVA as contracted_kw (e.g. 6); Tempo is listed but not costed; no market offers yet. Italy: the supplier's own price (energy price and commercial fees) as filed with ARERA's Portale Offerte, before network tariffs, system charges, excise and VAT; region (e.g. lombardia, lazio) or national; gas in Smc as gas_m3; fixed-price household offers only (index-linked offers have no stated unit price and are not costed); prices from ARERA's Portale Offerte open data (CC BY 4.0). Austria: supplier energy price and base fee (Grundpauschale) incl. 20% VAT, as on the supplier's price sheet; Bundesland (e.g. wien, niederoesterreich, tirol) or national offers; gas in kWh; the supplier's energy price and base fee incl. VAT, grid fees and energy levies excluded; supplier price sheets read twice and refereed. Ireland: unit rates and standing charge incl. VAT, as the supplier publishes them (after the stated discount); connection urban or rural (standing charges differ); unit rates and standing charge incl. VAT; three-band smart tariffs not costed.

contracted_kw.description: ES: contracted power (potencia contratada) in kW. FR: subscribed power (puissance souscrite) in kVA.

existing_customer_of.description: Supplier the household is already with (unlocks existing-customer tariffs).

export_kwh.description: Yearly electricity exported to the grid (e.g. from solar panels), in kWh. Costed at each supplier's stated feed-in price.

fuel.description: dual = electricity and gas from one supplier.

max_term_months.description: Longest fixed term accepted, in months.

night_share.description: Share of electricity used at night / off-peak, 0 to 1 (two-rate meters).

period_shares.description: ES 2.0TD: share of use in P1 (punta), P2 (llano), P3 (valle); sums to 1.

region.description: Region or city (BE: Flanders/Wallonia/Brussels; GB: one of 14 regions or a city; ES: peninsula, Baleares, Canarias, Ceuta, Melilla; US: the electric utility, e.g. PECO, Con Edison, or a city it serves).

special_eligibility.description: True if the household qualifies for social or restricted tariffs.

stay_months.description: How long the household expects to stay, in months. A fixed contract's stated exit fee is added when the stay is shorter than its term; also the default horizon.
